tasks.short: Assess patients using actual prior-care information

steps.what: Review actual prior medical care and current presentation for the correctly identified patient
inputs: existing actual prior-care records with dates and sources
verified patient identity and current presenting information
outputs: checked prior-care context with absent or conflicting information explicit

steps.what: Conduct the actual primary patient assessment and clarify relevant history at the bedside
inputs: actual patient and current clinical observations
checked prior-care context with absent or conflicting information explicit
outputs: actual assessment findings, patient history and unresolved clinical concerns

steps.what: Integrate actual findings and prior-care evidence into the physician's clinical assessment
inputs: actual assessment findings, patient history and unresolved clinical concerns
checked prior-care context with absent or conflicting information explicit
outputs: human-formed clinical assessment and uncertainty

steps.what: Capture actual assessment findings and clinical reasoning using approved verbatim chart dictation or entry
inputs: actual assessment findings, patient history and unresolved clinical concerns
human-formed clinical assessment and uncertainty
outputs: complete actual primary-assessment note draft

steps.what: Approve the completed assessment note after checking actual meaning, attribution, negation and omissions
inputs: complete actual primary-assessment note draft
actual assessment findings, patient history and unresolved clinical concerns
outputs: approved final actual primary-assessment note

steps.what: Save the approved actual primary-assessment note in the patient chart
inputs: approved final actual primary-assessment note
outputs: saved actual primary-assessment note

tasks.design: Configure a source-linked prior-care view and approved verbatim dictation in the clinical chart {OPS_SYSTEM}. The physician performs and interprets the actual assessment, captures the actual note and checks the complete final version before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chart navigation and typing can add effort around the primary assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views and verbatim dictation can reduce retrieval and typing without producing clinical judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain history, rapidly changing condition and immediate clinical interpretation remain physician work.
tasks.human_edge: The physician connects the actual bedside presentation with the reliability and relevance of prior records.

ambition.what: Reduce record handling while retaining the actual primary assessment and clinical reasoning.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for clinical-system approval and staff/patient privacy review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical charts can display prior-care records and support approved verbatim dictation; assessment and diagnosis remain clinician responsibilities.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional, not measured emergency-care baselines or clinical guidance.
Actual prior-care records must exist with source and date; absent records remain unavailable rather than generated.
s4 retains seven hours per 100 for actual dictation or typing and correction; no free transcript is assumed and no model summarises the encounter.
Native views and dictation first. Urgent bedside care takes precedence; this record workflow does not require waiting for documentation before necessary care.
No saving in bedside assessment, clinical reasoning or the same-chart save.
unknowns: Suitability and existing use of approved dictation
research_questions: Does native record configuration reduce net navigation and entry after full note review?

already_counted.description: Check complete actual assessment note for faithful clinical meaning

incremental.description: Maintain prior-care view permissions and handle dictation/access exceptions

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual primary-assessment note; edits return to s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 7.5 prior-record hours +3 typing hours =10.5. Upkeep 1.5 gives central net 9%; three extra hours correcting record mismatches or dictation gives high 6%. Low zero if native features are already used or unsuitable.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate likely outcomes to patients or representatives

steps.what: Determine the likely outcomes of the actual disease or traumatic condition and the limits of the evidence
inputs: actual patient findings and clinical course
available case-specific evidence
verified representative relationship where relevant
outputs: physician's actual outcome assessment, uncertainty and communication needs

steps.what: Communicate likely outcomes to the actual patient or representative and respond to their understanding and concerns
inputs: physician's actual outcome assessment, uncertainty and communication needs
actual patient or representative questions and responses
outputs: actual explanation, recipient responses and agreed or unresolved points

steps.what: Record the actual outcomes discussion using approved verbatim dictation or direct chart entry with correction
inputs: actual explanation, recipient responses and agreed or unresolved points
actual recipient identity and representative relationship
outputs: complete actual outcomes-discussion note draft

steps.what: Approve the completed discussion note after checking exact meaning, uncertainty, recipient and responses
inputs: complete actual outcomes-discussion note draft
actual explanation, recipient responses and agreed or unresolved points
outputs: approved final actual outcomes-discussion note

steps.what: Save the approved actual outcomes-discussion note in the patient chart
inputs: approved final actual outcomes-discussion note
outputs: saved actual outcomes-discussion note

tasks.design: Configure approved verbatim dictation in the clinical chart {OPS_SYSTEM} for the physician's actual post-discussion note. The physician determines and explains likely outcomes personally, then dictates or enters what actually occurred and checks the complete note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Typing a faithful record can add effort after a sensitive outcomes discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dictation can reduce typing while retaining the physician's actual words and corrections.
tasks.still_hard: Prognostic uncertainty, distress and understanding what the patient or representative needs require human communication.
tasks.human_edge: The physician can pace the explanation and recognise when the other person has not understood uncertainty.

ambition.what: Reduce note typing while preserving the complete personal discussion.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–4 for approved dictation and clinical privacy review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved verbatim dictation can assist clinical note entry while a clinician checks the final record; it does not replace prognosis or patient communication.

assumptions: Provisional shares and savings, not measured outcomes-discussion baselines.
The physician authors the actual note in s3; its retained 14 hours per 100 include speaking, direct entry and correction.
No ambient recording, free upstream transcript, generated prognosis or inferred patient agreement is assumed.
Native dictation first. The actual outcome judgement, conversation and same-chart save have no saving.
Any later written patient message is a separate completed payload and gated send, with no distribution saving included here.
unknowns: Correction burden for the physician's actual note style
research_questions: Does dictation reduce net entry time while preserving uncertainty and attribution?

already_counted.description: Check complete actual discussion note for faithful meaning

incremental.description: Handle dictation vocabulary, access and configuration exceptions

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual outcomes-discussion note; edits return to s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only note entry changes: 20*(1-0.70)=6 gross hours. One upkeep hour gives central net 5%; two extra hours correcting dictation gives high 3%. Low zero if dictation is already used or correction removes its benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review actual patient condition trends, results and current treatment records
inputs: existing actual time-stamped observations and results
current actual treatment orders and administration records
verified patient identity
outputs: checked condition trends and unresolved data issues

steps.what: Monitor the actual patient at the bedside and reassess changing symptoms and findings
inputs: actual patient and current findings
checked condition trends and unresolved data issues
outputs: actual reassessment findings and clinical concerns

steps.what: Reevaluate treatment and choose whether and how the actual clinical plan needs to change
inputs: actual reassessment findings and clinical concerns
checked condition trends and unresolved data issues
current actual treatment orders and administration records
outputs: physician's actual treatment decision and rationale

steps.what: Prepare the exact clinician-chosen treatment order using current patient fields and approved order-entry functions
inputs: physician's actual treatment decision and rationale
verified patient identity and current order context
actual clinician-selected order details
outputs: complete exact treatment order draft with all patient-specific details

steps.what: Approve the completed exact treatment order against the actual patient, clinical decision and current order context
inputs: complete exact treatment order draft with all patient-specific details
physician's actual treatment decision and rationale
outputs: approved final exact patient treatment order

steps.what: Commit only the exact approved treatment order to the internal clinical order system
inputs: approved final exact patient treatment order
outputs: committed exact patient treatment order

steps.what: Capture actual reassessment findings, the chosen treatment decision and rationale in the patient note
inputs: actual reassessment findings and clinical concerns
physician's actual treatment decision and rationale
committed exact patient treatment order
outputs: complete actual reassessment note draft

steps.what: Approve the completed actual reassessment note against findings and the exact chosen treatment
inputs: complete actual reassessment note draft
actual reassessment findings and clinical concerns
outputs: approved final actual reassessment note

steps.what: Save the approved actual reassessment note in the patient chart
inputs: approved final actual reassessment note
outputs: saved actual reassessment note

tasks.design: Configure current condition views and existing order-entry fields in the clinical system {OPS_SYSTEM}. The physician reassesses the actual patient and chooses treatment; only repeated record retrieval and patient-field entry change, with separate approval and commit of the complete order and separate approval and save of the actual note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewing condition trends and repeating patient/order fields can add work around treatment reevaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical trend views and approved order-entry functions can reuse existing verified context.
tasks.still_hard: Changing condition, uncertain evidence and the treatment decision remain physician responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: The physician can recognise when the actual bedside condition conflicts with an apparently reassuring trend.

ambition.what: Review current condition evidence more readily while retaining bedside reassessment and treatment authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for clinical order permissions and care-team consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical systems can display condition trends and reuse verified patient context in order entry; clinicians retain treatment selection and final order approval.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured emergency treatment baselines or medical guidance.
Actual observations and administration records are produced by the care team in existing work; absent data remain unavailable and their capture is not assumed free.
The physician supplies every treatment detail. Native defaults are checked and are never evidence of a clinician's decision.
This scenario describes a changed-order episode. If treatment is unchanged, remove the order steps and refit the scenario rather than claiming an avoided order.
Native views and entry functions first. Urgent care follows the actual clinical workflow; this model does not impose documentation delays before necessary care.
Same-system order commit and note save receive no saving. Treatment administration by other staff is neither automated nor claimed as saving.
research_questions: Which retrieval and repeated-field effort remains after approved native features?

incremental.description: Maintain clinical views and approved order-field settings with clinical owners

approvals.approved_version: approved exact patient treatment order with every clinician-selected field; changes return to s5
approved final actual reassessment note; edits return to s8

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 10 trend-retrieval hours +3 repeated-order-field hours =13. Two upkeep hours give central net 11%; four extra hours resolving record and order-context mismatches gives high 7%. Low zero if native features already cover these steps.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and coordinate emergency medical staff

steps.what: Review actual patient-flow status, staff availability and existing clinical responsibilities
inputs: existing actual patient-flow board
actual staff availability and responsibility records
outputs: checked operational context and gaps

steps.what: Determine actual clinical coordination priorities and appropriate responsibilities for the available medical staff
inputs: checked operational context and gaps
actual staff competence, workload and patient-care needs
outputs: physician's actual coordination priorities and proposed responsibilities

steps.what: Direct and coordinate nurses, assistants, specialists, residents and other staff through actual team discussion
inputs: physician's actual coordination priorities and proposed responsibilities
staff's actual responses, constraints and acknowledgements
outputs: actual agreed responsibilities and unresolved coordination issues

steps.what: Capture actual agreed clinical responsibilities, owners and unresolved conditions in the coordination record
inputs: actual agreed responsibilities and unresolved coordination issues
outputs: complete actual staff coordination record draft

steps.what: Prepare the written internal coordination message using actual recorded responsibilities and exact colleague recipients
inputs: complete actual staff coordination record draft
verified internal staff recipients
outputs: complete exact internal coordination message and recipients

steps.what: Approve the completed coordination record and exact internal message against actual team agreements
inputs: complete actual staff coordination record draft
complete exact internal coordination message and recipients
outputs: approved final staff coordination record and exact message

steps.what: Send the exact approved coordination message to the approved internal medical staff recipients
inputs: approved final staff coordination record and exact message
outputs: sent internal medical staff coordination message

steps.what: Save the approved actual staff coordination record
inputs: approved final staff coordination record and exact message
outputs: saved actual clinical coordination record

tasks.design: Configure current patient-flow and staff-context views in the clinical operations system {OPS_SYSTEM}, with a native coordination-message template. The physician chooses responsibilities, directs the actual team and records actual agreements before the completed message and record receive approval and their separate send/save actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retrieving current operational context and formatting written coordination can add work around direct team leadership.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical operations views and message fields can reuse actual records without assigning staff automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical priorities, competence, workload and live coordination require accountable medical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The physician notices when a formally available staff member cannot safely take another responsibility.

ambition.what: Review unresolved team responsibilities with current operational context.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for operational access and clinical staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical operations boards can show actual patient and staff context and reuse recorded responsibilities in coordination messages; staff assignment decisions remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares and savings, not measured emergency staffing baselines.
The clinical team already maintains actual patient flow and staff availability; missing updates must be obtained and counted.
Actual agreements are produced in s3 and captured in s4. No free structured assignment feed or inferred acknowledgement is assumed.
The message communicates coordination, not an unrepresented medication or procedure order. Any clinical order uses its own complete payload and approval workflow.
Native views and templates first. No saving in live direction, actual agreement capture, internal transmission or same-system save.
research_questions: Which context retrieval and message formatting remains repetitive after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check complete actual staff coordination record and exact message

incremental.description: Maintain permitted operational views and coordination-message fields

approvals.approved_version: approved exact internal coordination message and staff recipients; changes return to s6
approved final actual staff coordination record from s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 6 context-retrieval hours +4 message-formatting hours =10. One upkeep hour gives central net 9%; three extra hours resolving stale operational context gives high 6%. Low zero with current native coverage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: clinical team: maintain actual observations and acknowledge responsibilities
clinical systems owner: govern record views, order-entry settings and dictation
medical leadership: retain authority over clinical priorities and care
role.ambitious_version: An emergency physician with less repetitive record handling, retaining bedside assessment, treatment decisions, patient communication and direct team leadership.
